development.uses: training scores, runtime, reference parity and variation counters only

validation.test_selection: exclude new training and previous selected train/test inputs; held-out test is not used for candidate or configuration selection

profiling: nsys only; profiled runs are diagnostic and excluded from speedup estimates
controls: GPU evaluation and GPU reproduction remain the mainline; CPU reference scoring is explicit, counted and timed; exact verification disabled by default
selection: freeze final candidate and validation scale using development training/parity/runtime before new heldout scoring
preservation: previous experiment artifacts and binary remain immutable; all failed and rejected attempts retained; deadline never resets
